items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: Well, I was going to ask, Paul, I think about your family some more.

ctx.x: Still plays up there, the Jehovah's Witnesses.

Well, my mother partly raised those two boys. Oh, really? They rented a little room upstairs in the back of our house. My mother rented them. But their mama and their dad was always working and my mother used to feed them and everything. Now, Kid Rene, she was responsible for him making his first communion. Yeah. We had rent their mother a room. Well, I was going to ask, Paul, I think about your family some more.

I don't like to keep harping about the family, but the farther back we can go naturally, the better we like this older material. Did any of your other relatives, any uncles, did your father have any brothers or anyone else in his family that played music? Oh, yeah. Did you knew of him?
